# VM Joe's 10-ball historical fixture

Only the 19-player final table survived. `expected-final-table.json` normalizes placement, round markers, MP, reporting scores, rack totals, average PERF, and starting/final GBR values.

No matches, opponents, byes, rack scores by match, or race lengths are reconstructed. A `-` marker remains an uninterpreted non-play marker. Historical GBR/PERF values may come from a different legacy frontend or configuration revision. The unchanged CSV under `legacy/` remains the source evidence.
